```{r setup}
root <- tryCatch(rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("_targets.R")), error = function(e) "../..")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
setwd(root)
source(file.path(root, "R", "load.R"))
source(file.path(root, "R", "expression.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyr); library(ggplot2) })
design <- load_design()
out_dir <- file.path(root, "hypotheses", "H22", "output")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

species_all <- c("Apul", "Peve", "Ptuh")
traits <- c(AFDW = "Host_AFDW.mg.cm2", calc = "calc.umol.cm2.hr")
tps <- c("TP1", "TP2", "TP3", "TP4")
n_perm <- 200
max_pc <- 20
alpha_en <- 0.5
n_cores <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("H22_WORKERS", max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)))
n_lambda <- 100L
set.seed(20261008)
```

## Pre-registered decision rule

> - `supported` if dR2 > 0 with BH q < 0.05 for at least one trait in at
>   least two species.
> - `not supported` if dR2 <= 0 for both traits in at least two species.
> - `inconclusive` otherwise.

dR2 = out-of-sample R² of the molecular model (baseline + expression PCs,
elastic net) minus that of the baseline (`y[t+1] ~ y[t] + timepoint`), with
the outer CV holding out one site. Amendment 1 (`hypothesis.md`, before any
analysis) adapts this to the two sites that exist (two folds of 5 colonies;
site is confounded with nutrient), caps the PCs at training rows − 1, fixes
the elastic-net and null details, and keeps traits on the raw scale. p is
from 200 within-transition permutations of y[t+1] among training colonies;
q is BH across the two traits within species.

Implementation notes (not in `hypothesis.md`; none changes the rule):

- Timepoint enters as dummies for the transition (TP2→TP3, TP3→TP4 vs
  TP1→TP2). A dummy that is constant in a training fold is dropped from
  both models in that fold.
- Amendment 2 (2026-10-12) moves filtering, normalization, VST, centering,
  PCA, and any standardization into each outer and inner training fold.
  Inner colony validation selects one of 100 penalty fractions, pooling
  squared errors over validation rows.
- Frozen expression transforms are shared with H26 through `R/expression.R`.
  Preprocessing is cached before response permutations; all model fitting
  and penalty selection are repeated for every permutation.
- Every fold asserts that its training and held-out colonies are disjoint.

## Data

```{r data}
phys <- load_physiology() |> select(sample_id, all_of(unname(traits))) |>
  group_by(sample_id) |> summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
orth <- load_orthologs()

prep_species <- function(sp) {
  counts <- round(as_count_matrix(genes_by_ortholog(sp, orthologs = orth)))
  info <- design |> filter(has_genes %in% TRUE, sample_id %in% colnames(counts)) |> select(sample_id, colony, site, nutrient, timepoint) |>
    left_join(phys, by = "sample_id") |> mutate(t = match(timepoint, tps))
  rows <- lapply(names(traits), function(tr) {
    col <- traits[[tr]]
    a <- info |> transmute(sample_id, colony, site, t, y0 = .data[[col]])
    b <- design |> filter(species == sp) |> select(sample_id, colony, timepoint) |> left_join(phys, by = "sample_id") |>
      transmute(colony, t = match(timepoint, tps) - 1, y1 = .data[[col]])
    a |> inner_join(b, by = c("colony", "t")) |> filter(is.finite(y0), is.finite(y1)) |>
      mutate(trait = tr, interval = factor(t, levels = 1:3), species = sp)
  })
  list(species = sp, counts = counts[, info$sample_id, drop = FALSE], rows = bind_rows(rows))
}
dat <- lapply(setNames(species_all, species_all), prep_species)

n_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(dat, function(d) d$rows |> group_by(species, trait) |>
  summarise(rows = n(), colonies = n_distinct(colony), Mahana = sum(site == "Mahana"), Manava = sum(site == "Manava"),
            .groups = "drop") |> mutate(raw_ortholog_genes = nrow(d$counts))))
write_csv(n_tab, file.path(out_dir, "n_per_species.csv"))
knitr::kable(n_tab)
```

## Model

```{r functions}
dummies <- function(r) cbind(i2 = as.numeric(r$t == 2), i3 = as.numeric(r$t == 3))

# Filter and fit the expression representation using unique training libraries.
# Held-out counts are transformed with frozen training parameters only.
prepare_fold <- function(X, tr, te, zscore_genes = FALSE) {
  stopifnot(!any(te$colony %in% tr$colony), !any(te$sample_id %in% tr$sample_id))
  train_ids <- unique(tr$sample_id); test_ids <- unique(te$sample_id)
  counts <- filter_expressed(X[, train_ids, drop = FALSE])
  if (!nrow(counts)) stop("No expressed genes in training fold")
  v <- norm_fold(counts, X[rownames(counts), test_ids, drop = FALSE])
  sd_gene <- apply(v$train, 1, sd)
  variable <- is.finite(sd_gene) & sd_gene > 0
  v$train <- v$train[variable, , drop = FALSE]
  v$test <- v$test[variable, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(v$train)) stop("No variable genes in training fold")
  Xtr <- t(v$train[, tr$sample_id, drop = FALSE])
  Xte <- t(v$test[, te$sample_id, drop = FALSE])
  mu <- colMeans(Xtr)
  scaling <- if (zscore_genes) apply(Xtr, 2, sd) else rep(1, ncol(Xtr))
  Xtr <- sweep(sweep(Xtr, 2, mu), 2, scaling, '/')
  Xte <- sweep(sweep(Xte, 2, mu), 2, scaling, '/')
  k <- min(max_pc, nrow(Xtr) - 1L, ncol(Xtr))
  if (k < 1) stop("Too few training samples for PCA")
  pc <- prcomp(Xtr, center = FALSE, rank. = k)
  D_tr <- dummies(tr); D_te <- dummies(te)
  keep <- apply(D_tr, 2, function(z) length(unique(z)) > 1)
  B_tr <- cbind(y0 = tr$y0, D_tr[, keep, drop = FALSE])
  B_te <- cbind(y0 = te$y0, D_te[, keep, drop = FALSE])
  Z_tr <- cbind(B_tr, pc$x)
  Z_te <- cbind(B_te, Xte %*% pc$rotation)
  list(tr = tr, te = te, B_tr = B_tr, B_te = B_te, Z_tr = Z_tr, Z_te = Z_te,
       penalty = c(rep(0, ncol(B_tr)), rep(1, ncol(pc$x))), k = k,
       gene_ids = rownames(v$train), train_ids = train_ids,
       center = mu, scaling = scaling, rotation = pc$rotation)
}

prepare_outer_fold <- function(X, tr, te, zscore_genes = FALSE) {
  outer <- prepare_fold(X, tr, te, zscore_genes)
  colonies <- unique(tr$colony)
  if (length(colonies) < 2) stop("Too few training colonies for inner CV")
  inner <- lapply(colonies, function(cc) {
    train <- which(tr$colony != cc); valid <- which(tr$colony == cc)
    list(train = train, valid = valid,
         design = prepare_fold(X, tr[train, ], tr[valid, ], zscore_genes))
  })
  list(outer = outer, inner = inner)
}

# PCA spaces differ across folds; align paths by fractions of each training
# fit's maximum lambda. Ties choose the largest penalty fraction.
penalty_fractions <- function(d) {
  minimum <- if (nrow(d$Z_tr) < ncol(d$Z_tr)) 0.01 else 0.0001
  exp(seq(log(1), log(minimum), length.out = n_lambda))
}

fit_path <- function(d, y, fractions) {
  glmnet::glmnet(d$Z_tr, y, alpha = alpha_en, penalty.factor = d$penalty,
                 standardize = TRUE, nlambda = length(fractions), lambda.min.ratio = min(fractions))
}

fit_fold <- function(fold, y1_train = fold$outer$tr$y1) {
  fractions <- penalty_fractions(fold$outer)
  losses <- lapply(fold$inner, function(f) {
    fit <- fit_path(f$design, y1_train[f$train], fractions)
    predictions <- predict(fit, f$design$Z_te, s = fit$lambda[1] * fractions)
    colSums((predictions - y1_train[f$valid])^2)
  })
  mse <- Reduce('+', losses) / sum(vapply(fold$inner, function(f) length(f$valid), 0L))
  fraction <- fractions[which.min(mse)]
  d <- fold$outer
  base <- lm.fit(cbind(1, d$B_tr), y1_train)
  pred_base <- drop(cbind(1, d$B_te) %*% base$coefficients)
  fit <- fit_path(d, y1_train, fractions)
  lambda <- fit$lambda[1] * fraction
  pred_mol <- drop(predict(fit, d$Z_te, s = lambda))
  tibble(row = d$te$row, y1 = d$te$y1, pred_base = pred_base, pred_mol = pred_mol, k = d$k,
         n_pc_selected = sum(as.matrix(coef(fit, s = lambda))[-(1:(ncol(d$B_tr) + 1)), 1] != 0),
         lambda_fraction = fraction, lambda = lambda, genes = length(d$gene_ids),
         training_samples = length(d$train_ids), training_colonies = n_distinct(d$tr$colony))
}

r2_pooled <- function(p) {
  sst <- sum((p$y1 - mean(p$y1))^2)
  c(R2_base = 1 - sum((p$y1 - p$pred_base)^2) / sst, R2_mol = 1 - sum((p$y1 - p$pred_mol)^2) / sst)
}

# Cache label-independent preprocessing for outer and nested inner folds.
prepare_cv <- function(X, rows, by = "site") {
  rows <- rows |> mutate(row = row_number())
  groups <- unique(rows[[by]])
  folds <- parallel::mclapply(groups, function(f) {
    tr <- rows[rows[[by]] != f, ]; te <- rows[rows[[by]] == f, ]
    prepare_outer_fold(X, tr, te)
  }, mc.cores = min(n_cores, length(groups)))
  if (any(vapply(folds, inherits, logical(1), 'try-error'))) stop("Fold preprocessing failed")
  names(folds) <- groups
  folds
}

run_cv <- function(folds, permute = FALSE) {
  preds <- bind_rows(lapply(names(folds), function(name) {
    f <- folds[[name]]
    tr <- f$outer$tr
    y1 <- tr$y1
    if (permute) for (g in unique(tr$t)) { i <- which(tr$t == g); y1[i] <- y1[i][sample.int(length(i))] }
    fit_fold(f, y1) |> mutate(fold = name)
  }))
  list(preds = preds, r2 = r2_pooled(preds))
}

evaluate <- function(d, trait, by = "site", rows_filter = function(r) r) {
  rows <- rows_filter(d$rows |> filter(.data$trait == !!trait))
  folds <- prepare_cv(d$counts, rows, by)
  obs <- run_cv(folds)
  null <- unlist(parallel::mclapply(seq_len(n_perm), function(i) {
    set.seed(20261008 + i)
    r <- run_cv(folds, permute = TRUE)$r2
    r[["R2_mol"]] - r[["R2_base"]]
  }, mc.cores = n_cores))
  if (!is.numeric(null) || length(null) != n_perm || any(!is.finite(null))) stop("Invalid permutation results")
  dR2 <- obs$r2[["R2_mol"]] - obs$r2[["R2_base"]]
  list(summary = tibble(species = d$species, trait = trait, cv = by, rows = nrow(rows),
                        R2_base = obs$r2[["R2_base"]], R2_mol = obs$r2[["R2_mol"]], dR2 = dR2,
                        null_dR2_median = median(null), null_dR2_95 = quantile(null, 0.95),
                        p = (1 + sum(null >= dR2)) / (1 + length(null)),
                        mean_pcs_selected = mean(obs$preds$n_pc_selected), pcs_available = max(obs$preds$k),
                        min_genes = min(obs$preds$genes), max_genes = max(obs$preds$genes)),
       preds = obs$preds |> mutate(species = d$species, trait = trait, cv = by), null = null)
}

decide <- function(s) {
  s <- s |> group_by(species) |> mutate(q = p.adjust(p, "BH")) |> ungroup()
  per <- s |> group_by(species) |>
    summarise(any_pass = any(dR2 > 0 & q < 0.05), both_nonpos = all(dR2 <= 0), .groups = "drop")
  verdict <- if (sum(per$any_pass) >= 2) "supported" else if (sum(per$both_nonpos) >= 2) "not supported" else "inconclusive"
  list(per_trait = s, per_species = per, verdict = verdict)
}
```

```{r primary}
res <- lapply(species_all, function(sp) lapply(names(traits), function(tr) evaluate(dat[[sp]], tr, "site")))
res <- unlist(res, recursive = FALSE)
primary <- decide(bind_rows(lapply(res, `[[`, "summary")))
write_csv(primary$per_trait, file.path(out_dir, "dr2_summary.csv"))
write_csv(bind_rows(lapply(res, `[[`, "preds")), file.path(out_dir, "predictions.csv"))
write_csv(bind_rows(lapply(res, function(r) tibble(species = r$summary$species, trait = r$summary$trait, null_dR2 = r$null))),
          file.path(out_dir, "null_dr2.csv"))
knitr::kable(primary$per_trait, digits = 3)
```

**Primary verdict: `r primary$verdict`.**

```{r fig, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}

  group_by(species, trait) |> mutate(row = row_number()) |> ungroup() |> select(species, trait, row, site), by = c("species", "trait", "row")) |>
  pivot_longer(c(pred_base, pred_mol), names_to = "model", values_to = "pred") |>

  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(trait ~ species, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(baseline = "grey45", `baseline + expression` = "#1b6ca8")) +
  labs(x = "Predicted y[t+1] (held-out site)", y = "Observed y[t+1]", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "observed_vs_predicted.png"), g, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 150)
g
```

## Sensitivity checks

```{r sensitivity}
sens_loco <- decide(bind_rows(lapply(species_all, function(sp) bind_rows(lapply(names(traits), function(tr)
  evaluate(dat[[sp]], tr, "colony")$summary)))))
sens_no34 <- decide(bind_rows(lapply(species_all, function(sp) bind_rows(lapply(names(traits), function(tr)
  evaluate(dat[[sp]], tr, "site", rows_filter = function(r) r |> filter(t != 3))$summary)))))
write_csv(sens_loco$per_trait, file.path(out_dir, "sens_leave_one_colony_out.csv"))
write_csv(sens_no34$per_trait, file.path(out_dir, "sens_drop_tp3_tp4.csv"))
knitr::kable(bind_rows(sens_loco$per_trait |> mutate(check = "leave one colony out"),
                       sens_no34$per_trait |> mutate(check = "TP3->TP4 dropped")) |>
               select(check, species, trait, rows, R2_base, R2_mol, dR2, p, q), digits = 3)
```

## Secondary: cross-species transfer (descriptive)

Train on the paired rows of one species and test on another. Expression
preprocessing and gene/response standardization use source training rows
only (Amendment 2). No permutation null and no decision.

```{r transfer}
common <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(dat, function(d) rownames(d$counts)))
transfer <- bind_rows(lapply(species_all, function(a) bind_rows(lapply(setdiff(species_all, a), function(b)
  bind_rows(lapply(names(traits), function(tr) {
    tr_rows <- dat[[a]]$rows |> filter(trait == tr) |> mutate(row = row_number())
    te_rows <- dat[[b]]$rows |> filter(trait == tr) |> mutate(row = row_number())
    mu <- mean(c(tr_rows$y0, tr_rows$y1)); sigma <- sd(c(tr_rows$y0, tr_rows$y1))
    tr_rows <- tr_rows |> mutate(y0 = (y0 - mu) / sigma, y1 = (y1 - mu) / sigma)
    te_rows <- te_rows |> mutate(y0 = (y0 - mu) / sigma, y1 = (y1 - mu) / sigma)
    X <- cbind(dat[[a]]$counts[common, ], dat[[b]]$counts[common, ])
    fold <- prepare_outer_fold(X, tr_rows, te_rows, zscore_genes = TRUE)
    p <- fit_fold(fold)
    r <- r2_pooled(p)
    tibble(train = a, test = b, trait = tr, genes = length(fold$outer$gene_ids),
           R2_base = r[["R2_base"]], R2_mol = r[["R2_mol"]],
           dR2 = r[["R2_mol"]] - r[["R2_base"]])
  }))))))
write_csv(transfer, file.path(out_dir, "cross_species_transfer.csv"))
knitr::kable(transfer, digits = 3)
```

```{r summary}
verdicts <- tibble(analysis = c("primary (leave one site out)", "leave one colony out", "TP3->TP4 dropped"),
                   verdict = c(primary$verdict, sens_loco$verdict, sens_no34$verdict))
write_csv(verdicts, file.path(out_dir, "verdicts.csv"))
knitr::kable(verdicts)
```

## Caveats

- About 10 colonies per species: 5 per site, so each fold trains on 5
  colonies (about 13–15 rows).
- Site is confounded with nutrient; "novel conditions" means the other
  site and nutrient regime, and nothing more.
- No independent cohort exists; held-out site and held-out species are
  proxies.
- Raw-scale traits; AFDW includes negative values from upstream.
